news.paragraph: The iShares Russell 2000 ETF (IWM) has seen mixed commentary recently, with some analysts pointing to small caps benefiting from AI spending while others caution that the recent rally might be a dangerous trade. Wells Fargo has flagged potential earnings and debt issues within the small-cap space, contrasting with a more bullish view on AI-driven growth.
